intro: Comparing amounts and equality: more books than, as many hours as, as hot as, more than a hundred, the same as.
p.tan: as (before an adjective or adverb, in tan…como)
p.tantas horas como.nota: Tanto agrees with the noun: tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas.
p.el mismo.nota: It agrees: la misma, los mismos, las mismas.
b1.texto:
With **nouns**: **más** / **menos** + noun + **que**: tengo **más** libros **que** tú.

As much, as many: **tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas** + noun + **como**. It agrees with the noun: **tantas** horas **como** tú.

With **adjectives or adverbs**: **tan + adjective/adverb + como**: el café está **tan caliente como** el té. **Tan** does not change; the adjective agrees with the noun when its form allows it.

With **verbs**: trabaja **más que** yo; gana **menos que** yo; no gasto **tanto como** tú. Here **tanto** does not agree with a noun.

Before a **number**, than is **de**, not que: **más de** cien euros, **menos de** mil.

For the same person or thing: **el mismo** horario **que** tú; **tengo la misma profesora que** tú.

Also: **igual que**, **diferente de**, **parecido a**, **el doble**, **la mitad**. Pronunciation varies: c before i may sound like s (seseo) or like the th in think (distinción).
b3.f0: Do you work as many hours as your brother?
b3.f1: No, he works more than me, but he earns less.
b3.f3: Less than a thousand euros. I earn twice as much as he does.
a7: twice as much as he does
b3.f4: I have the same hours as you, but I don't spend as much as you.
b3.f5: The thing is, my flat costs more than eight hundred euros a month.
b5.pregunta: Complete: I have as many books as you.
b6.pregunta: Complete: it costs more than a hundred euros.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Before a number, than is de.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Que is used when you compare two things.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Como goes with tan and tanto.
b7.pregunta: Complete: I work as much as you.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Que goes with más and menos.
b8.pregunta: Complete: we have the same teacher. (la profesora)
b8.o2.refuerzo: Lo mismo is the same thing, with no noun.
b9.pregunta: Complete: the coffee is as hot as the tea.
b9.o0.refuerzo: Tan goes before an adjective in tan…como.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Tanto compares quantities or goes with a verb.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Tanta agrees with a feminine noun.
b11.traduccion: I don't spend as much as you.
b12.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write comparisons of equality about you and a friend: Trabajo tanto como…, tengo tantos… como…

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Compare aloud life now and life ten years ago using tan… como and tanto… como.
